title: 2022 CODATA: mag. flux quantum is 2.067 833 848... × 10^−15
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks mag.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks mag. flux quantum as exact: 2.067 833 848... × 10^−15 Wb. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. The magnetic flux quantum is the flux step in superconducting devices. The 2022 listing marks it exact and prints an ellipsis.
